Fleetwood Gardens — 16068 83 Avenue

A 55+ apartment-condo building: a current listing record states building type Apartment/Condo, freehold strata, Strata Plan BCS1550, built 2005, 46 homes in 4 storeys, with strata restrictions recorded as age restrictions (55+), pets allowed with restrictions (cats and dogs OK, maximum 1) and "Rentals Allwd w/Restrctns" — the rental half of that line is void: rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022; the 55+ and pet lines are lawful bylaw types, confirmed on the Form B. The same record names NAI Goddard & Smith as manager — manager identity is a Form B check, not relied on here.

items.t: Fleetwood Tynehead is a single board sub-area — one of 15 sub-areas of the Fraser Valley board community "Surrey" in the SnapStats data — not a combined page for two neighbourhoods. Municipally it sits in the City of Surrey's Fleetwood community: the City's Fleetwood Plan guides growth over the next 30+ years as SkyTrain extends along Fraser Highway, over a plan area running from Green Timbers Urban Forest in the west towards the Agricultural Land Reserve in the east, while the Anniedale-Tynehead ground at the east end is planned under its own City plan process.

Transit: two Surrey Langley SkyTrain stations will serve this sub-area directly — Fleetwood Station at the northeast corner of 160 Street and Fraser Highway, and Bakerview-166 Street Station at the northwest corner of 166 Street and Fraser Highway with an integrated transit exchange — on the 16-kilometre Expo Line extension from King George Station to Langley City. No station operates here today.

blocks.text: Good to know about Fleetwood Tynehead condos

items.t: Two stations, one sub-area — and neither exists yet. Fleetwood Tynehead is the rare Surrey sub-area with two named stations on the funded extension (160 Street and 166 Street on Fraser Highway) — but the Fleetwood Plan itself is mid-update, with Council consideration of the updated plan in 2026, so both the transit map and the density map for this area are plans in motion, not settled facts.

The attached market here is two different markets. Town-centre-side low-rise apartments (Fleetwood Gardens 2005, Manarola 2014–2015) versus Tynehead-side townhouse communities of up to 302 homes (Canopy) — a single "Fleetwood attached" comparable set mixes forms, ages and buyer pools that do not compete with each other.
This sub-area's attached pace beat most of Surrey in September 2026.

A 55+ building hides inside a family-market sub-area. Fleetwood Gardens' 55+ bylaw makes its buyer pool, financing conversations and resale comparables different from every other named complex here — and its own listing record still carries a rental-restriction line that has been void law since 2022.
Zone names in older Fleetwood material are stale. Surrey's July 8, 2024 SSMUH changes renamed the former RF/RF-SS zones to R3, RF-12/RF-12C/RF-13 to R4 and RF-SD to R6.

The east end is a different planning world. The plan area runs from Green Timbers Urban Forest toward the ALR, and Tynehead-side acreages carry Anniedale-Tynehead plan and drainage context that standard Fleetwood lots do not — confirm ALR status and plan area for any east-end listing before valuing it.

Fleetwood Tynehead home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

158 townhomes sold in Fleetwood Tynehead with a median price of $800,000 (the middle half sold between $726,625 and $844,500), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 97.6% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $505 per square foot, a median year built of 2008 and a median strata fee of $408 a month. 41 condos sold in Fleetwood Tynehead with a median price of $510,000 (the middle half sold between $439,900 and $590,000), taking a median of 32 days to sell at 97.8% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $670 per square foot, a median year built of 2022 and a median strata fee of $415 a month.

faq.a: The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board counted 141 condos and townhomes listed in Fleetwood Tynehead at the end of October 2026. The number changes daily, so ask Jared for today’s count.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Fleetwood Tynehead?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Fleetwood Tynehead had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Fleetwood Tynehead a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: Fleetwood Tynehead accounted for 84 of the 737 condos and townhomes sold across Surrey from June to October 2026.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Fleetwood Tynehead from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.a: The age bylaw governs who may live in the unit, not who may own it, and SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 carry exemptions (younger spouse/partner, live-in caregiver, legacy residents, defined child cases). The building's listing record states a 55+ restriction — read the registered bylaw on the Form B before writing, especially if anyone under 55 would reside there.
faq.q: I'm under 55 — can I buy at Fleetwood Gardens?

faq.a: The restriction half is void: no BC strata has been able to enforce a long-term rental-restriction bylaw since November 24, 2022. The same record's pet line (cats and dogs OK, maximum 1) and 55+ line are lawful bylaw types and stand until the Form B says otherwise.
faq.q: Fleetwood Gardens' listing says rentals are allowed with restrictions — what applies?

faq.a: Fleetwood Station (160 Street and Fraser Highway) and Bakerview-166 Street Station are named stations on the Surrey Langley SkyTrain project; TransLink states an anticipated in-service date of 2029 for the 16-kilometre extension. Price the plan, not a service that does not yet operate.
Both — it is a mixed complex, and the answer depends on the address. Built form governs per component; only the townhouse component counts as a townhouse complex.
faq.q: Is Abbey Road a condo or a townhouse complex?

faq.a: The building record's bylaw summary says "Age restrictions" without stating an age, and since November 24, 2022 only a 55+ bylaw is enforceable at all (Strata Property Act, ss. 123.1–123.2). Read the actual bylaw in the Form B package before assuming any age rule — and note the same summary's "rentals not allowed" line is void.
